overview.objective: Let investors sign in to the fund portal securely with an OTP, within device limits, and complete KYC before access.
overview.background: Investors share credentials and register too many devices. Support unlocks accounts by hand.
overview.history: Device limits were introduced after credential-sharing incidents.

roles.decision_rights: May access only their own profile and holdings

modules.name: Investor Registration & Access
modules.purpose: Authenticate investors and verify them before they reach the portal

features.name: Investor OTP & Access Verifier
features.trigger: Investor submits a login request with an OTP
features.action: Validate OTP and enforce RBAC device limits
features.check: Verify OTP matches secure vault and device count is under limit

bound.on_exhaustion: lock the profile and alert platform operations

success_criteria: OTP matches and no RBAC policy violation within 3 attempts
features.output: auth_status, user_role and a JWT for the session
features.handoff: Append each attempt with iteration pass, device fingerprint, OTP match evidence and access scope
notifications: Notify platform ops on account lockout

features.name: Investor KYC Verifier
features.trigger: An authenticated investor has no completed KYC record
features.action: Send the investor's identity documents to the KYC provider
features.check: The provider's decision is APPROVED and the name matches the profile

bound.on_exhaustion: send to platform operations for manual review

success_criteria: KYC approved and profile name matches
features.handoff: Append each submission with provider reference and decision
notifications: Alert platform ops when KYC is escalated

constraints: At most 3 active devices per investor
Never store OTP values in audit tables

acceptance_criteria: No portal access without approved KYC

assumptions: The KYC provider answers within 30 seconds
open_points: Which KYC provider is used in production
